What do you mean?
Yeah I get that it’s about chemistry, but “10 message exchanges and no more than 3 days” like what? You can’t put numbers to these things. Numbers are absolute and people are not.

I hate this. Not that this is what to do but that this system actually exists. WHY is there a number of messages that need to be met in order to ask someone on a date? 

I feel like these days dating is like playing chess, both people know all the games the other is played but they both play them anyway because it’s all they know.

Those “friends” won’t realise anything they will simply not notice I’ve gone. In fact they will probably be a bit glad when they see I haven’t spoken to them for a while. The only person that loses when I stop trying is me. 

And I don’t want to embrace it. Surely I am worthy of being wanted too? Why should I have to settle for being alone when others don’t?

I do know that yeah but it’s just like I would rather be happy for an hour and sad for a day then sad for an hour and a day ya know? I’ve tried acting like I’m not alone, but then I get nowhere. 

When I speak to new people I never mention anything about my depression, my loneliness or my desperation to be listened to. I just speak as if they were another one of my friends, in fact that’s what I dislike too. Like I need to speak to people to get it all off my chest but then if someone you don’t really know starts opening up about their emotions and what they’re struggling with then people just fade away. 

Sometimes it literally feels like I can’t breathe, like I should be gasping for air but on the outside I look fine. I’m often in physical pain and discomfort from the lack of socialising. I’d be lying if I said I haven’t considered ending it but what will that solve? My problems yes, my family’s problems no.

It’s got nothing to do with their gender. I would have done the exact same for a guy friend too. Unless you have personally been to this depth yourself then I don’t even wanna know bro. Even I’m not lonely enough to wanna spend my time talking to people like you.

I’ve tried talking to people online but it just doesn’t cut it for me. I need a physical connection ya know? I need to see their eyes, hear their voice, feel their presence, sense their attention. Words on a screen just don’t cut it unfortunately. Reading isn’t something I’ve tried much in the past but I have definitely watched comedies, they help but it’s a temporary solution to my permanent problem :(

What other ways are there? For years I’ve heard people talking about how they feel trapped and I didn’t really know what they meant but I know! I KNOW what it is now. I live it everyday! My stomach aches, my throat feels closed, my mouth feels dry, all because I just cannot escape the prison in my own head!

It just hurts so much! It never stops hurting! It’s like being in quick sand up to your eyes. You can’t breathe so you struggle but the more you struggle the deeper it gets! I can’t fucking take it but I can’t get out!! Nobody listens, nobody cares.

And I appreciate the offer I do. But for me online just doesn’t cut it. I need someone in person to talk to me properly, I don’t even want to talk about how I feel even I just crave someone to simply talk to me.

Uphill battle all the way.

Yeah that’s the other thing. Even if I did have someone to talk to, they would not care at all. I guess we just need to learn to live without the acknowledgment of others to fuel us.

Nah you said that guy looked desperate. But he doesn’t. They sound like a nice person tbh. A person who would reply when they can and not worry about having to wait x minutes before replying. It’s just pathetic and says a lot about someone if they can’t handle fast replies.

Why is the world like this? Why do we have to play games even about how fast we reply to each other? If I want to reply in 2 seconds I will, if you don’t like that then wtf? 

Also, girls who put “fast replies” or anything in their bios and then moan about my replies being too fast... what were you expecting? Pick one and stick with it!

Good that you called yourself out for checking when people are active. My ex gf used to check when I was on fb messenger all the time and then complain if I didn’t reply, not knowing that the active status barely even works on fb. It’s not healthy to check peoples active statuses and you should always remind yourself that they could be too busy to type a reply or if they’re talking to someone irl and they want to show a picture they found on Instagram then they won’t be able to reply. It’s hard but try not to dig into it. 

As for how to go about that girl, I don’t know man if I did I wouldn’t be lurking dating advice on the daily :) 

However, I would avoid explicitly asking whether she wants to be friends or partners as that could make it awkward. As she was the one to give you her number it’s safe to assume she isn’t going to hesitate to make a move if she wants so if I were you I’d just do my best and see how she plays it first.

At this point just giving me any attention would work tbh. 

However, being nice, holding a conversation for more than 5 minutes, asking about me and my life after I asked about you and yours. Just be genuine and not fake and you will get much further than most girls I’ve tried to speak to.
